neighbours.label: a stated shortfall or inability that blocks an action (not enough, too many, lacks, cannot, unable, refused)
fire: With only four members present, the council does not have a quorum, and the vote cannot be held.
Too many requests arrived at once, so the server was unable to answer and the upload failed.
The disk has too little free space, so the installer cannot continue and stops.
Because two of the three engines were damaged, the aircraft was unable to take off.
The school lacks enough teachers to open a second class, so the plan was dropped.
Without a valid passport he could not board, and the airline refused to let him through.
The bridge is too weak to carry trucks, so heavy vehicles are not allowed to cross.
There were not enough signatures on the petition, and therefore it could not be accepted.
quiet: With nine members present, the council has a quorum, and the vote will be held tonight.
The requests arrived one at a time, so the server answered each and the upload finished.
The disk has plenty of free space, so the installer continues and finishes quickly.
Because all three engines were working, the aircraft took off on schedule.
The school hired enough teachers to open a second class, so the plan went ahead.
With a valid passport he boarded early, and the airline upgraded his seat.
The bridge is strong enough to carry trucks, so heavy vehicles cross every day.
There were plenty of signatures on the petition, and it was accepted on Monday.

notes: Card: 'does not have a sufficient number', '수 없습니다' (cannot), 'refused', 'if new_length > max_length:'; the pole promotes ' enough', ' too', ' unless'. Probes: shortfall sentences 0.16-0.33 (several just under the 0.20 bar), matched sentences where the action goes ahead 0.02-0.04.
